python_interfaces.name: SiteRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Site has stable Customer Organization ownership; ordinary update never changes customer_org_id

python_interfaces.name: SiteDispatchRepository
python_interfaces.rule: exact one dedicated Dispatch Location per Site and at most one Site per Dispatch Location; relationship owned here while Dispatch Location entity remains LLD-02

python_interfaces.name: RoomRackRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Room owns one Site; Rack owns one Room and derives Site through Room

python_interfaces.name: NetworkElementRepository
python_interfaces.rule: immutable physical instance identity and authoritative Site; descriptive values never form identity; Model changes go through history-preserving NetworkElementModelRepository rather than a shortcut column writer

python_interfaces.name: NetworkElementPlacementRepository
python_interfaces.rule: site-level/unracked and Rack placement are valid; Rack-derived Site must equal immutable Network Element Site

python_interfaces.name: DeviceReferenceResolutionRepository
python_interfaces.rule: one Device Reference resolves to at most one current Network Element; multiple Device References may resolve to one physical Network Element only through explicit reviewed relationships

python_interfaces.name: DeviceReferenceResolutionReader
python_interfaces.rule: read-only registration context; operational relationships continue to target Device Reference identity

python_interfaces.name: ContainmentRepository
python_interfaces.rule: one current direct parent and service cycle guard; containment has no placement/Cloud/connectivity side effects

python_interfaces.name: CloudRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Deployment owns exactly one Site+Cloud Type; Network Element assignment must be same Site and at most one current

python_interfaces.name: NetworkElementIpRepository
python_interfaces.rule: canonical address is descriptive; one canonical address per Network Element and at most one primary, cross-element duplicates remain candidates

python_interfaces.name: ModelCompatibilityRepository
python_interfaces.rule: reusable model/BOM compatibility is reference knowledge, never installed-instance truth

python_interfaces.name: NetworkElementModelRepository
python_interfaces.rule: optional Model assignment is history-preserving and cannot bypass model-assignment events

python_interfaces.name: InstalledComponentRepository
python_interfaces.rule: component instance identity belongs to one Network Element and preserves slot/serial/install/remove/correction history independently of Model compatibility

python_interfaces.name: DevicePartInstalledComponentResolution
python_interfaces.rule: links two immutable identities without merge or ownership transfer; Inventory physical consequence remains LLD-07

python_interfaces.name: InventoryPhysicalConsequenceReader
python_interfaces.rule: maintenance-derived Installed Component changes consume minimized accepted physical-consequence evidence only; LLD-08 receives no Inventory/Task writer

python_interfaces.name: DispatchLocationService
python_interfaces.rule: Site coordinator invokes inside same outer UnitOfWork; no nested commit

python_interfaces.name: SiteDispatchAddressProvider
python_interfaces.rule: site-derived Dispatch Location display resolves Site current address without duplicating it into dispatch_locations

python_interfaces.name: SiteOperationalDependencyValidator
python_interfaces.rule: writer guard is bounded/indexed and fail-closed; detailed enumeration outside writer lock

python_interfaces.name: SiteDependencyRegistry
python_interfaces.rule: closed composition-root registration; no runtime arbitrary plugin authority

python_interfaces.name: DataInstanceIdentityReader
python_interfaces.rule: Infrastructure workbook SourceInstallationScopeId is exactly this opaque non-secret data_instance_id; LLD-08 never invents or persists a competing installation identity

python_interfaces.name: DeliberateActionProofVerifier
python_interfaces.owner: LLD-12 consumed here with LLD-10 interaction contract
python_interfaces.rule: Device Reference promotion/regularization proof is server/session-bound; client boolean/timestamp is never sufficient

python_interfaces.name: InfrastructureWorkbookRepository
python_interfaces.rule: unpublished staging/proposals are technical only; cleanup is terminal-only; accepted workbook rows never bypass normal Infrastructure services

python_interfaces.name: InfrastructureWorkbookService
python_interfaces.rule: source workbook is never modified; parsing/staging/proposal calculation is non-authoritative and accepted batch invokes owning services atomically

cross_domain_transaction_rule: CreateSite uses one outer LLD-08 UnitOfWork/receipt, invokes LLD-02 DispatchLocationService inside it, inserts Site and one-to-one link, and commits once. Device Reference and Device Part Unit resolution mutations write only LLD-08 relationship tables and never mutate LLD-03/07 identity or lifecycle tables. Maintenance component changes only validate through the LLD-07 reader. Workbook acceptance uses one outer receipt/UoW for all selected domain mutations.
reader_rule: Previews use stable snapshots; uniqueness, Site consistency, occupancy, cycle, primary-IP, resolution, Inventory-consequence freshness and archival decisions are re-read inside the current UnitOfWork before mutation.
